All 158 Rust files inventoried; 745 public function headers include cfg(test) helper methods and are not 745 production APIs. Subsystem ownership comes from spec/spec.md: core/interface/NFR/FR037-039; oracle FR014/018/021/031/035/042; kani FR015/017/025/028/029/030/034/040/041; routed FR019/022/026; replay FR016/024/032/033; strategy FR002/008-013; evidence FR004/036; publication FR005/NFR001. No confirmed new reverse gap or hollow implementation. The two tiny mod files declare real modules rather than stub behavior. Raw placeholder/panic candidates were inventoried; test assertions and intentional refusal paths are not stubs. No measured code-coverage percentage available. Coverage engine lists five untracked symbols and ten diagnostics; explicit attributes confirm only three genuinely absent criterion tag occurrences, all FR-049 at src/routed/contract_package_tests.rs:1575,1655,1656. FR-322 and AD-004 appearances reported as untracked by the broad engine originate in prose rather than stale explicit attributes; do not invent two defects from them. Method-without-symbol50 is not automatically a missing test. Ignored-only18 name real separate lanes; author evidence is reviewed as logs, not evidence-store discharge. All311 findings are inherited and not demands to implement blocked parent capabilities in this PR. The L-2 defect is reported once in SR-14220. Source/record differential checks cover four integer operators and i64 boundaries in existing reference-emitter tests; new tests provide partial AC3 generation retention/mutation assertions only.
